web_det_shibuya.title: Shibuya scramble crossing - detection
web_det_shibuya.caption: Around 190 pedestrians per frame are picked out at a famously crowded crossing, down to the far side of the street.
web_det_shibuya.author: Mixkit
web_det_shibuya.license: Mixkit Stock Video Free License (free for commercial and personal use, no attribution required)
web_det_shibuya.model: D-FINE-seg X detection fine-tuned on VisDrone (det_x_2026-02-21), conf 0.4, 1280x736 input
web_det_shibuya.notes: VisDrone2019-DET X model (640x640 training, test-dev mAP50 0.443, F1 0.591), run at 1280x736. The high camera angle is close to VisDrone's drone views: ~185 people per frame at conf 0.4 vs ~42 with the COCO X model (obj2coco, same input size; the web_det_shibuya_coco render). VisDrone classes: 'pedestrian' = walking/standing, 'people' = other poses; no bags or traffic lights. 1920x1088 input finds fewer (~71); 640x640 is similar to 1280x736 (~176). PyTorch. Segment 0-10 s, 30 fps. The model inherits VisDrone's non-commercial terms.

web_sem_reef_lady_musgrave.title: Great Barrier Reef coral survey - coral semantic segmentation
web_sem_reef_lady_musgrave.caption: A snorkeller glides over table corals, branching Acropora and a sandy channel full of fish; every pixel is sorted into coral, sand, rock and fish.
web_sem_reef_lady_musgrave.author: Adam Fish (Wikimedia Commons)
web_sem_reef_lady_musgrave.model: D-FINE-seg X semantic segmentation trained on Coralscapes (39 classes), 1024x2048 input
web_sem_reef_lady_musgrave.notes: Coralscapes X checkpoint x_bs2_mos08_rcs (train split only; test 58.38 mIoU); Coralscapes is Red Sea imagery, this is Lady Musgrave Island (GBR) - an out-of-distribution generalization test. Segment 29-41 s, ~12 fps (every 5th frame of 59 fps). Fine-grained coral types (table / branching / other Acropora) can trade places frame to frame; the coarse groups (live coral, sand, fish, water) stay stable.

web_kpts_street_dance.title: Street dance crew - human pose
web_kpts_street_dance.caption: Five dancers on a night-lit basketball court, each tracked with a 17-point skeleton through a full choreography.
web_kpts_street_dance.author: Mixkit
web_kpts_street_dance.license: Mixkit Stock Video Free License (free for commercial and personal use, no attribution required)
web_kpts_street_dance.notes: Released COCO person-keypoint S weights, 640x640, PyTorch. Segment 0-12 s, 24 fps. conf 0.75 suppresses a painted mural of a face on the left wall that otherwise scores up to ~0.75 as 'person'; at that threshold a half-hidden dancer drops out for a few frames.

web_sem_goose_dusk_road.title: Country road at dusk - off-road semantic segmentation (hero)
web_sem_goose_dusk_road.caption: A winding country road at dusk: drivable ground, lane markings, roadside vegetation and sky, every pixel.
web_sem_goose_dusk_road.author: Mixkit
web_sem_goose_dusk_road.license: Mixkit Stock Video Free License (free for commercial and personal use, no attribution required)
web_sem_goose_dusk_road.model: D-FINE-seg X semantic segmentation trained on GOOSE 2D (11 categories), 1024x2048 input
web_sem_goose_dusk_road.notes: GOOSE val 69.84 mIoU, 95.63 pixel acc (official val split; categories from the GOOSE paper's Table II, void ignored). GOOSE groups asphalt with drivable ground ('terrain'); 'road' is curbs, sidewalks, markings and rails, so the lane lines show as 'road'. Segment 0-12 s, 24 fps. Shown with the model view on the left of the hero handle.
